description: This file contains unit tests for the SAML2 authentication functionality in the Users module of SuiteCRM. It tests the behavior of the SAML2 authentication process, including access checks, error handling for incomplete settings, and generating metadata XML with valid settings.

classes.name: SAML2AuthenticateTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing SAML2 authentication features within the SuiteCRM Users module.

methods.name: testEntryPointNoAuth
methods.description: Tests that the entry point does not require authentication and expects false.

methods.name: testIncompleteSettings
methods.description: Tests the behavior when incomplete SAML settings are provided, expecting an exception to be thrown.

methods.name: testMinimalValidExample
methods.description: Tests that valid SAML settings produce correct metadata XML, checking for expected content and proper parsing.
